text:
maria: Hey infra team — pushed a tiny keystore override to the RiverBend enterprise repo to workaround a JKS -> PKCS12 mismatch. PR: https://git.redwood/repos/riverbend/merge_requests/512 Please can someone take a quick look? Onboarding pipelines are failing for their private deploy.

eli: on it, giving it a quick pass now.

shawn: is this the change that sets KEYSTORE_TYPE=PKCS12? if so we should be careful for older 1.3 installs.

maria: yep, only sets KEYSTORE_TYPE for riverbend/prod; diff is 3 lines. snippet: ```
env:
  KEYSTORE_PATH: /etc/keystore/riverbend.p12
  KEYSTORE_TYPE: PKCS12
``` Might need a migration note.

samira: left a comment on the MR about adding a migration flag and a short rollback note. also found a unit test failing in auth pkg — CI shows `TestLoadKeystore` failing.

eli: CI looks flaky — rerun pipeline? @deploy-bot can we trigger a rebuild?

deploy-bot: Rebuild requested by eli. Build 342 -> queued.

shawn: if tests still fail I'll try to replicate locally. Maria, can you add a short note in the MR description about why this is safe for enterprise customers and the rollback plan?

maria: adding now. will also add a changelog entry under riverbend/CHANGELOG.md. thanks for the quick eyes 🙏

eli: quick thumbs — approve if CI green and samira is okay with test fix. :thumbsup:

samira: eyes on the test — looks like a path resolution assumption. I'll push a tiny follow-up to normalize path handling, that won't change behavior in prod.

maria: sounds good. i'm going to mark the MR ready for merge when CI is green + samira's patch.

shawn: ping me 10 mins before merge window, i'll watch the rollout.
